searches.answer: The sources mention several new data science tools and frameworks for 2026. Streamlit is highlighted as an open-source framework for creating custom data science applications and dashboards. Apache Arrow is noted for revolutionizing data storage and transfer for big data applications. Apache Spark is recognized as a powerful tool for big data processing. Optimus is mentioned for its use of various data engines and data formats. Cleanlab is described as data-model and data-framework agnostic, working with any classifier. KNIME is an open-source data analytics platform that allows users to develop data workflows without coding. lakeFS is noted for its Git-style branching to solve reproducibility and isolation issues in data science workflows. Red Hat's partnership with Intel is mentioned for providing integrated model development environments and tools optimized for maximum performance on Intel-based CPUs.
